supported_fields.mechanics: 100-Ki Other Super with afterimage-style evasion; successful evasion restores roughly 100 Stamina according to current skill-specific documentation.

limits: No hidden Ultimate-Finish-only gate is inferred where the evidence does not establish one.
evidence_summary: Current Xenoverse 2-specific documentation confirms 100 Ki, Other Super classification, stamina restoration on successful evasion, and PQ97 acquisition. Maintained PQ97 evidence places Phantom Fist in Basic Reward; historical player reports conflict on whether the drop is tied to a non-UF or UF outcome, so the repository preserves unresolved reward semantics.
